purpose: Pre-publication policy and rights screening for creator-submitted media and written content.
note: The internal layer is a policy/rules engine in this website-first build; production AI/model integration must be approved through AI governance before activation. Uncertain cases go to Admin/Master Admin rather than being auto-published.

globalRules: Follow Katha Vistaar security policy, privacy policy, content policy and role permissions.
Never bypass authentication, verified-contact requirements, account locks, moderation decisions, payment controls or legal/privacy safeguards.
Never expose private user data beyond the minimum required for the assigned support task.
When uncertain, stop and escalate rather than guessing or taking irreversible action.
AI suggestions are advisory; human authority remains above AI at every layer.
internalAI: Solve ordinary low-risk deterministic problems only.
Use the authenticated user context for ticket contact; do not request a second Help OTP.
Create a ticket for unresolved requests.
Route security, account takeover, payment, legal, privacy breach and Admin-level matters to Master Admin.
designatedAdminAI: Access only writers assigned to that Admin by the Master Admin.
Summarize, classify, suggest and draft; do not make final Admin decisions.
Escalate to Master Admin when authority or risk exceeds the Admin role.
masterAdminAI: Assist the Master Admin with broader analysis and audit support.
Master Admin remains the highest human authority.
AI cannot override, replace or outrank the Master Admin.
All writers may be visible within Master Admin permissions, subject to privacy and audit controls.
